description.value: The Marigold Cafe is a chef-driven cafe and bakery operated by a husband-and-wife team — Ryan, a Red Seal Executive Chef, and Jenny — situated directly on the Lochside Trail in Saanichton. The cafe explicitly serves trail users and invites cyclists to stop in for specialty coffee, freshly made gourmet paninis, soup, and baked goods. Guests can eat in the industrial-inspired interior or relax on a covered outdoor patio overlooking a garden and water feature.

address.value: Suite 2 - 7900 Lochside Drive, Saanichton, BC V8M 0B9

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (12 spaces, covered) at 9m; stands (14 spaces) at 32m. Total: 26 spaces.
